propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted, untracked top-level directories exist in the ticket tracker with fsck findings of MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH, all older than 30 minutes with no open file handles, indicating interrupted write debris.
rebar tracker-maintenance --clean is an all-or-nothing operation that deletes all entries returned by fsck.foreign_store_path_list with no per-directory filter or CLI subset selection.

A five-guard per-directory triage confirms all 8 stray directories are empty, uncommitted, non-existent (rebar exists returns 1), have zero open handles, and have mtimes older than 30 minutes, establishing they are safe to remove.

The run-level gate requires rebar tracker-maintenance --status to report a foreign list byte-equal to exactly the 8 triaged ids immediately before cleanup; on any mismatch the sweep aborts with no writes.
After executing rebar tracker-maintenance --clean, fsck reports zero MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings, with no committed ticket data modified and tracker HEAD unchanged.
